objective: The coordinator's go-ahead of 2026-11-26 on the advisor's top direction: the advisor's built start of 14 knots (three rings of four joined through two knots that share one distinction) should carry three ring facts, each read by no single knot, whose sum the knots' laws force. Test it with the binding study's code at rounds 0 to 3 under both readings of a small change, with its controls (remove the shared distinction of the joining knots; give one joining knot a loose distinction); the canonical checker on the relation of the three facts; the closing test (is a birth that takes its parents' loose distinctions implied exactly when the rest of its connected structure holds none; not-all-equal as control); then whether growth makes such a set of knots from a start without one. Stop at a growth-made binding with a frozen test, or at a clean negative on the sets frozen.
status: Complete 2026-11-26; refereed R1: confirmed with fixes, one Block. title: A built binding of three whole-held facts: made by the law, and does growth make one?
